lead: `bun nv try` runs the `covws` build from the start of the session, so a Rust fix you just made is not in it.
body: The runner reads `NVS_BIN` first and falls back to that binary, so a re-run after an edit prints the old behaviour and looks like the fix did nothing. Run `cargo build`, then `NVS_BIN=target/debug/nvs.exe bun nv try …` (the same variable works for `bun nv proofs --bless`).
